title: How a Paper Airplane Glides
logline: A paper airplane stays aloft by exchanging speed for aerodynamic lift while drag steadily slows it.

scenes.voiceover: Why does a paper airplane glide instead of dropping straight down? Gravity pulls it lower, but forward motion redirects air around its angled wings, creating lift. Drag gradually steals speed, so lift weakens—and the airplane finally descends.
scenes.visual: Minimalist stickman demonstration of launch, airflow, and descent on a white background with selective yellow accents.
